abilitygroupdescription.p: Shield abilities refer to any combat training with a shield or buckler.

abilitydescription.p: ability:block When a character is attacked they may attempt to block the blow using their shield instead of making an armour roll. This ability spends the characters reaction for the round. If the block result fails and a boon is rolled the attack deals half damage. If the block result fails and a bane is rolled the attack deals double damage. If the block check succeeds the attack does no damage. If the block succeeds and a boon is rolled the blocker smashes the attacker in the face with the shield for 2 damage.

action.name: Push
action.precondition: This character is in melee with an opponent of similar size or smaller.
action.critsuccess: Opponent is Pushed twice and knocked Prone.

abilitydescription.p:
Shield Push
The character can use the shield to push an adjacent opponent back in a direction chosen by the character. The opponent must be corporeal, humanoind, capable of being moved, and not too much larger than the character.

action.name: Talent
action.precondition: This character, or an adjacent character, is hit by a physical attack.
action.effect: The character may make a Shield Block as a free interrupt in place of the failed defence.

abilitydescription.p:
support
Large shields provide Support. The character wielding a large shield can use their reaction to block attacks on adjacent allies. In order to use this ability the ally must be standing shoulder to shoulder with the character.
Adjacent characters get a shift up for block, parry and armour opposing-actionchecks.
